Definition: from the base of G5088; art (as productive), i.e. (specially), a trade, or (generally) skill:--art, craft, occupation.
BiblicalUsage: The word is art, craft, the skill of the workman. Paul tells Athens that the Godhead is not like unto gold or silver or stone, graven by art and man's device; Paul worked at the same craft as Aquila and Priscilla, for by their occupation they were tentmakers; and the voice of craftsmen shall be heard no more at all in fallen Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that art can carve an idol or pitch a tent, and the same skill serves God or serves itself.
